notes: Selfridges Home (UK), scoped to Home & Furniture per project scope note. Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl), no WAF/bot-block; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (a generic '*newness*' substring disallow exists for all user-agents but the verified URL path uses the segment 'newin', not 'newness', so it is not covered by that rule). Navigation discovery: the site runs one cross-department 'New In' merchandising concept, exposed per-department in the main nav mega-menu list (Men's, Bags, Shoes, Beauty, Kids, 'Home & tech', Food Hall, Women's all have their own New In link). The Home & tech department's own link is https://www.selfridges.com/GB/en/cat/home-tech/newin/, which mixes Home and Technology (title-bar shows 313 results total). To scope strictly to Home & Furniture (excluding Technology) I used the site's own 'categories' facet on that page, which reports FacetEntry count=275 for name='Home' (seoPath 'home & tech|home') vs count=39 for 'Technology' - this is the same site-computed left-nav filter count methodology used in the prior Home-Decor pass for this company. I then verified this facet value directly by requesting the Home-scoped URL https://www.selfridges.com/GB/en/cat/home-tech/home/newin/, which independently rendered '275 results' in both the desktop-top-bar-result-count and mobile-result-count elements - an exact match confirming the number via two independent readings. This Home facet's own category sub-breakdown (Dining 54, Pet accessories 39, Candles & home fragrance 37, Kitchen 35, Home accessories 28, Stationery 26, Lighting 19, Bedroom 18, Bathroom 15, Laundry & cleaning 4, Household electrical 2) shows no Furniture bucket at all, meaning there are currently 0 new-in Furniture items (Fredhopper-style facets omit zero-count entries) - Furniture is a genuine sub-category of this Home department (confirmed via /GB/en/cat/home-tech/home/furniture/) so it is included in scope, it simply has no new arrivals right now. No further genuine named children of 'New Arrivals' exist for Home (no separate 'New Arrivals - Lighting' etc. nav destinations; the sub-facets are generic in-page filters, not distinct merchandised pages), so a single row is emitted per the brief's 'do not invent sub-categories' rule. Also checked and excluded: no 'Bestsellers'-in-name New Arrivals variant, no local-language equivalents needed (UK/English site only), sitemap.xml sub-sitemaps returned empty/redirected and were not usable for discovery (not needed - nav-based discovery was conclusive).

rows.evidence: desktop-top-bar-result-count and mobile-result-count both read "275 results" on https://www.selfridges.com/GB/en/cat/home-tech/home/newin/; independently corroborated by the 'categories' Facet on https://www.selfridges.com/GB/en/cat/home-tech/newin/ where FacetEntry {"count":275,"name":"Home","seoPath":"home & tech|home"}
